title: Package the conformance runner source closure
scope: Remove repository-test source dependencies from the conformance component so its declared source tree can configure and build solely against a relocated installed SDK.
acceptance: The conformance component has an explicit self-contained source closure with no parent-relative dependency on tests/api or other unshipped repository internals.
A contract test rejects future source references that escape the copied conformance component.
The full SDK install checker passes configure, build, corpus input, installed-runner, unsupported-case and missing-driver checks after relocating a clean install.
